summary_claims.claim: Mission to 'minimise surprise to the UK and humanity from rapid and unexpected advances in AI'; three core functions (Functions section).
Institute is not a regulator and will not hold responsibility for release decisions.

note: GOV.UK paper and the 'AI Safety Institute: overview' page confirm publication on 2 Nov 2023, CP 960 and the update of 17 Jan 2024. The script warning on date_published concerns only the PDF quote that shows 'November 2023'; the overview page gives the day. Status Superseded rests on DSIT's 14 Feb 2025 renaming of the institute as the AI Security Institute, a judgment unchanged from the published record. No newer version beyond GB-07.
